common.save.title: Save
common.save.what: Writes your changes and keeps you on the page so you can carry on editing.
common.save.when: Part way through a long form, or when you want to check the effect of a change before leaving.
common.save.learnerSees: Whatever the setting changes, as soon as it is saved. Saving is not the same as making something visible to learners.
howTo: Make the change.
Click Save.
Look for the confirmation before navigating away.
common.save.verify: Reload the page: a saved change survives the reload.
gotchas: Brightspace does not always warn before you leave a page with unsaved edits.
Saving a grade setting can recalculate the whole gradebook, so expect final grades to move.

common.save-and-close.title: Save and Close
common.save-and-close.what: Writes your changes and returns you to the list you came from.
common.save-and-close.when: You are finished with this item.
howTo: Make the change.
Click Save and Close.
Confirm the item shows your change in the list.
common.save-and-close.verify: The list you return to should show the edited item with its new values.
gotchas: In the activity editors this is the step that actually creates the item. Closing any other way can discard it.

common.cancel.title: Cancel
common.cancel.what: Leaves without saving. Anything typed since the last save is discarded.
common.cancel.when: You opened something by mistake, or want to abandon a change.
howTo: Click Cancel.
Confirm the discard prompt if one appears.
common.cancel.verify: Reopen the item and check your change is not there.
gotchas: Cancel does not undo anything already saved, only the edits since.
Some editors ask 'Discard changes?' and some simply leave.

common.close.title: Close
common.close.what: Shuts the dialog. Whether your edits survive depends on whether you saved first.
howTo: Save first if you made changes.
Click Close.
common.close.verify: Reopen the dialog and confirm what you expected was kept.
gotchas: Closing is not saving. This catches people out on dialogs that have both.

common.close-dialog.title: Close dialog
common.close-dialog.what: Shuts the dialog without taking any further action.
howTo: Save first if you made changes, then close.
common.close-dialog.verify: Reopen and confirm the state is what you expect.

common.help.title: Help
common.help.where: Top right of most Brightspace tools
common.help.what: Opens D2L's own documentation for the tool you are in, which is the vendor's wording rather than MSU's.
common.help.when: You want the official description of a setting, or a link to send a professor.
howTo: Click Help on the tool's page.
Read the article for the tool you are actually in.
common.help.verify: Check the article matches your Brightspace version; D2L changes tools between releases.
gotchas: D2L documentation describes the product generally. MSU may have turned options off or renamed them, so confirm against the course before quoting it.

common.more-actions.title: More Actions
common.more-actions.what: A dropdown holding the actions that did not fit on the toolbar. In the gradebook this is where the event log, import and export, and bulk operations live.
common.more-actions.when: You cannot find an action on the page. It is usually here before it is anywhere else.
howTo: Click More Actions.
Read the whole menu before choosing; its contents differ by tool.
common.more-actions.verify: The menu contents depend on your role, so an action a professor describes may not appear for you.
gotchas: Menu contents vary by tool and permission, so instructions that name a More Actions item may not match what the professor sees.
In this simulator most of these menu items are reference only.
tickets: "I cannot find the option to restore a deleted grade column."

common.edit.title: Edit
common.edit.where: Row menus and item lists throughout Brightspace
common.edit.what: Opens the item for changes, usually in the editor the item was created in.
common.edit.when: Changing an existing assignment, quiz, grade item or module.
howTo: Open the chevron menu beside the item's name.
Choose Edit.
Change what you need and Save and Close.
common.edit.verify: The list shows the updated values afterwards.
gotchas: Editing an item that already has submissions or grades can change what those grades mean, particularly if points change.

common.apply.title: Apply
common.apply.where: Beside a filter or view selector
common.apply.what: Applies the filter or view you chose. The list does not change until you click it.
common.apply.when: After choosing a value in a view or filter list.
howTo: Choose the view or filter.
Click Apply.
Check the list has narrowed.
common.apply.verify: The list reflects the filter; if it did not change, Apply was not clicked.
gotchas: Filters persist as you move around a tool, which makes items look missing later. Clear the filter before concluding something is gone.
tickets: "My quiz has disappeared from the list."

common.print.title: Print
common.print.where: Top right of several Brightspace tools
common.print.what: Produces a printable version of what is on screen, respecting the filters and columns currently applied.
common.print.when: A professor needs a paper or PDF copy, often of the classlist or a grade export.
howTo: Set up the view you want first.
Click Print.
common.print.verify: Check the print view includes the rows and columns expected; hidden columns stay hidden.

common.export.title: Export
common.export.what: Downloads what is on screen as a file, typically CSV or Excel.
common.export.when: Work needs to continue outside D2L, or you need a correctly formatted file to import back.
howTo: Choose what to include, including the identifier column.
Export and open the file to check it.
common.export.verify: Row count should match the number of learners you expect.
gotchas: Always start an import from an export. Files built by hand usually fail to match learners.

common.new.title: New
common.new.what: Creates a new item in this tool. In the gradebook it opens a menu, because there are several kinds of thing you can create.
common.new.when: Adding an item, category or scheme.
howTo: Click New.
Choose the kind of item if a menu appears.
Fill the form and Save.
common.new.verify: The new item appears in the list.
gotchas: In Grades, choosing Item versus Category matters: a category groups items and carries the weight, an item holds the marks.

common.name.title: Name
common.name.what: The item or person's name. In a list it is usually both a link and the anchor for a chevron menu of actions.
common.name.when: Opening an item, or reaching the actions available for one row.
howTo: Click the name to open it.
Click the chevron beside it for the row's actions.
common.name.verify: The chevron menu is where per-row actions live; the plain name usually just opens the item.
gotchas: Two learners can share a name. Match on Org Defined ID when it matters.

common.overview.title: Overview
common.overview.where: First entry in the Content table of contents, and the first tab of several reports
common.overview.what: A summary page: in Content, the course overview a professor can write for learners; in a report, the headline figures before the detail.
common.overview.when: Getting your bearings in a tool you do not know.
howTo: Open Overview and read it before drilling into the detail.
common.overview.verify: In Content, an empty Overview is normal and not a fault.

common.show-search-options.title: Show Search Options
common.show-search-options.where: Beside a search box in Brightspace
common.show-search-options.what: Expands the search into a filtered search, letting you narrow by role, enrolment status, group or section rather than just matching text.
common.show-search-options.when: A plain search returns too much, or you need to find learners by something other than their name.
howTo: Click Show Search Options.
Set the filters you need.
Search again.
common.show-search-options.verify: The result count should fall once filters apply.
gotchas: Filters set here can persist and make people look missing from the list later.
tickets: "A student is not showing in my classlist."
